userMechanicPremise.description: Non-Super lane Troopers travel by zipline to the furthest captured lane point. Shooting any Trooper on the zipline once causes the transported group to fall and continue normally from that location.
userMechanicPremise.consequenceForTelemetry: The 1-HP CNPC_Trooper subclass should be tested as a transport/rider proxy whose 1->0 transition represents dismount/transport termination rather than economic Trooper death.

expectedWaveCompositionCrosscheck.caveat: Nearby-state association is diagnostic only because multiple waves, fights, and stale/persistent entity positions can occur in the same area.

interpretation.economicHandling: Exclude this subclass from Trooper kill/death/soul denominators.
interpretation.behavioralHandling: Retain it as a lane-mobility/transport state because proxy termination can mark where a wave becomes grounded and interactable.
interpretation.importantSuperException: If Super Troopers do not use the zipline transport proxy, transport presence/absence becomes an additional independent clue for Super classification.
interpretation.nextNeededDistinction: Separate natural zipline arrival from player-caused shoot-down. Bullet-ray/damage telemetry can later be aligned to these proxy termination cohorts.
